item.title: Aburatsu Fishing Port — Guide
item.description: Aburatsu, a port town in Nichinan on Miyazaki’s scenic southern coast, is a working fishing harbour known for its fresh seafood and relaxed, local atmosphere. The port is especially famous for katsuo (skipjack tuna/bonito), a Miyazaki speciality landed here in quantity, best enjoyed as sashimi or seared tataki. At the harbour, visitors can eat superbly fresh fish at local restaurants and markets. Aburatsu is also home to the charming ‘Aburatsu Akamachi’ shopping street, revitalised with a fun, retro, nostalgic feel and dotted with cafés, eateries and shops that make it a pleasant place to stroll.
